name: Tipaduma
summary: TIPADUMA is a free retro horror first-person shooter that runs in the browser. In the story mode "The Spellbook" the player crosses a foggy garden full of zombies, breaks into a haunted mansion with ghosts and living paintings, and fights an old hag with an axe in the attic to take her spellbook. Nine weapons from a chainsaw to a rocket launcher; furniture and walls break into voxels. Online Deathmatch. English and Russian.
